<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using criteria that describe the forward carbonyl‑ene reaction: breaking a C=C bond and a C=O bond, forming a new C‑C bond and a C‑O bond, and changing the bond orders of the C=C and C=O bonds. This should return templates that match the described transformation. I will then inspect the returned templates to identify the one that matches the given molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["hydroxyl", "five-membered ring"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=C", "C=O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2->1)", "C=O (2->1)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
